<!-- Thanks for contributing to SkyHub. Keep it small and focused where you can. -->

**What this changes**
A short description, and the why.

**Surface**
Which part? (web app / API / worker / DSP / plugin / desktop / docs / ci)

**Checklist**
- [ ] `just test` passes (or the relevant subset for the surface touched)
- [ ] No secrets, no personal/deployment data committed (`just audit` is clean)
- [ ] DSP change? sound-control / real-time-safety / parameter parity considered
- [ ] User-facing change? calm + accessible (contrast, reduced-motion, left-aligned, no alarm)
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed

See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md).
